messages:
Elaine: FYI just got an escalation from AcmeOps — their Embeddings chart shows a big jump at 09:12 UTC. Tooltip says "vectors" but billing shows token units. Customer says charges don't match UI screenshot. Screenshot/URL attached.

Matt: looking at billing logs for acct ACME - I see entries from two ingestion paths around that time: /v1/embeds.batch and /internal/vectors/stream. Both incremented 'embed_units'. possible double-count.

Vik: grabbing analytics data now. quick SQL to sanity-check:
```
SELECT ingestion_id, event_source, sum(units) as total_units
FROM embed_events
WHERE account_id = 'ACME' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T09:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T09:30:00Z'
GROUP BY ingestion_id, event_source
ORDER BY total_units DESC;
```

Vik: result shows same ingestion_id (abc-123) appearing twice with event_source = 'batch-upload' and 'replay'. totals line up to ~3x expected.

Priya: customer repro steps from their ticket: 1) POST batch of ~2k vectors to /v1/embeds with idempotency key X 2) internal replay job (kafka topic) replays same payload 3) dashboard aggregation sums events without dedup on ingestion_id -> double count

Elaine: Important: UI tooltip labels units as "vectors" but our billing pipeline converts model output -> token_estimate and charges tokens. That mismatch is causing the confusion in customer billing. We need to separate display metric vs billing metric.

Matt: agree. root cause looks like analytics transform merges both vector_count and token_estimate into a single units field. replay path sets a different event_type but downstream transforms map both to units, so dashboards + billing both read the same column.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started livefix branch analytics/dedupe-preserve-ingestion_id at 1893456880 :gear:

Vik: proposed fix: 1) aggregator: dedupe by (ingestion_id, event_hash) 2) preserve original_ingestion_id on replay path instead of nulling it 3) UI: change tooltip to show "vectors (count)" and a separate line for "billing tokens" with link to pricing doc. PR open: #4823.

Elaine: can we repro in staging before prod roll? @Priya can you run replay + batch with idempotency key and confirm aggregator dedupes?

Priya: running now. Repro steps I'm using:
```bash
# send batch
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/embeds -H 'Idempotency-Key: replay-test-01' -d @payload.json
# trigger replay job
kubectl exec -it jobs/replay-player -- /app/replay --topic embeds-replay --account ACME --since 2026-03-15T09:00:00Z
```
Logs from staging: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:34Z INFO embed_event produced ingestion_id="abc-123" event_hash="e9f2" source="batch-upload"
2026-03-15T09:12:36Z INFO replay produced ingestion_id=null event_hash="e9f2" source="replay"
```
Priya: aggregator previously didn't dedupe because replay path set ingestion_id=null. reproduces customer symptom.

Vik: aha — kafka-transformer intentionally nulled ingestion_id for replay events in older code. change is to set original_ingestion_id -> ingestion_id when present. small transform patch.

Matt: billing estimate: if double-counted, ACME saw ~3x embed units for that window. ballpark customer impact ~$120 extra. Recommend provisional credit while we confirm.

Elaine: agreed. I'll tell the customer we're provisioning a credit and patch will be rolled. ETA 4 hours. @Matt can you start credit workflow? :hourglass: 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolled hotfix to staging at 1893456950, running smoke tests.

Priya: staging smoke looks good — dashboard now shows single count and new tooltip clarifies vectors vs billing tokens. Running longer replay batch to be safe.

Vik: will queue prod rollout after SLA window. Follow-up tasks: ENG-embeds-568 (preserve ingestion_id), UX-embeds-129 (tooltip copy), BILL-credits-2026-03-15 (customer provisional credit).

Elaine: thanks team — closing loop once credit is posted and prod rollout completes. I'll update ticket and ping customer.

Matt: posted provisional credit ticket, reference BILL-credits-2026-03-15.

Priya: final smoke in staging at 1893457005 looks green. ready for prod.

Elaine: marking resolved for now. will reopen if customer sees recurrence.
